hillburrow/doctor-drunk-killed.entry:
The patient's chest doesn't rise anymore. The doctor drops what she was holding, and looks at you with eyes full of fury.

WHAT HAVE YOU DONE ?! He was STABLE ! I only needed a bag and a little time, and you had to play the hero, you reckless, arrogant BUTCHER !
hillburrow/doctor-drunk-killed.answer-apologize: I'm sorry. I thought I could save him.
hillburrow/doctor-drunk-killed.no-forgiveness: Sorry ? SORRY ?! Sorry won't put him back together ! Get out of my clinic. I never want to see your face or hear your voice again. And I'll make sure all of Hillburrow knows what you did !
